package dcs

// The env name is held in a const and the secret is also read by reference
// through a secretsource resolver: <NAME>_FROM is the companion.

import (
	"os"

	"github.com/go-authn/secretsource"
)

const (
	envPassword     = "WEFT_DCS_PASSWORD"
	envPasswordFrom = "WEFT_DCS_PASSWORD_FROM"
	envToken        = "WEFT_DCS_TOKEN"
)

func password() (string, error) {
	if ref := os.Getenv(envPasswordFrom); ref != "" {
		return secretsource.Resolve(ref)
	}
	return os.Getenv(envPassword), nil
}

// envToken has no companion: still a plaintext input.
func token() string { return os.Getenv(envToken) }
